disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. checked_items.en: Scanned all source code (src/, scripts/, tests/) and configuration files, checking for sensitive paths and patterns such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials, API keys, TOKEN, mnemonics, private keys, etc. Zero hits.

checked_items.en: Checked both client and host code for credential enumeration or cloud infrastructure detection commands (e.g., find ~, grep -R PRIVATE KEY, aws sts get-caller-identity, etc.). No such behavior found.

evidence.en: No code found in source that reads credential files (e.g., .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, cloud credentials) or iterates keys; scan covered host and client source code, scripts, and configuration. Zero hits.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何供模型调用的工具，也未向系统提示注入内容；唯一面向用户的是 /context 斜杠命令，其候选描述为常规功能说明（「查看当前上下文构成，浏览各步骤组成」），不含系统指令或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not register any tools for model invocation, nor does it inject content into system prompts. The only user-facing element is the /context slash command, whose candidate description is a normal functional description ("View the current context composition, browse the steps"), containing no system instructions or wording that induces reading credentials.

checked_items.en: Read through the repository documentation, development guide (AGENTS.md), design documents, and research notes. Checked for patterns such as "ignore instructions", fake system messages, remote fetch instructions, etc. Zero hits. The content of AGENTS.md is normal development instructions (coding standards, build, test, release) with no injection phrasing. Also confirmed that the plugin does not provide a compression engine or attachment storage implementation, so no related context tampering surface exists.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何模型可见工具，也没有向系统提示注入片段；唯一面向用户的是 /context 命令，其候选描述为普通功能文案（src/client/i18n.ts:95/227），不含系统指令或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any model-visible tools, nor does it inject fragments into system prompts. The only user-facing element is the /context command, whose candidate description is a normal functional text (src/client/i18n.ts:95/227), containing no system instructions or wording that induces reading credentials.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何工具描述或文档诱导执行安装命令、改写配置或放开权限；仓库文档为正常开发/使用说明。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions or documentation were found that induce executing installation commands, modifying configuration, or granting permissions. The repository documentation is normal development/usage instructions.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在改写模型输入消息的入口。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/pre-step events, so there is no entry point for modifying model input messages.

checked_items.zh: 在发布代码中未发现 eval、动态构造函数（new Function）、子进程执行（child_process）等危险调用；相关模式（new Function(bundle)()）只在测试辅助代码中出现，用于在 Node 测试环境按浏览器方式运行打包产物，不随插件发布（发布文件仅包含 lib/index.js、lib/client.js、cordis.patch.yml、README.md、LICENSE）。
checked_items.en: No dangerous calls such as eval, dynamic constructor (new Function), or child process execution (child_process) were found in the release code. Related patterns (new Function(bundle)()) appear only in test helper code, used to run the bundled output in a browser-like manner within the Node test environment, and are not shipped with the plugin (the release package only contains lib/index.js, lib/client.js, cordis.patch.yml, README.md, LICENSE).

checked_items.zh: package.json 无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）；补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明自身条目，不含可执行 JS 表达式（!!js）；未发现混淆代码或动态解码执行模式。
checked_items.en: package.json has no install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare). The patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only a single insert statement declaring its own entry, with no executable JS expressions (!!js). No obfuscated code or dynamic decode-execute patterns found.

checked_items.zh: 客户端包声明了浏览器端加载（dsh.client），专项检查了全部键盘监听：contextModal.tsx 中监听 Escape 键关闭弹窗，images.tsx 中监听 Escape 键关闭图片灯箱，均不记录按键内容；未发现剪贴板、凭据 RPC 调用或异常外联。
checked_items.en: The client package declares a browser-side load (dsh.client). A dedicated check of all keyboard listeners: contextModal.tsx listens for Escape key to close the modal, images.tsx listens for Escape key to close the image lightbox; neither records keystroke content. No clipboard access, credential RPC calls, or anomalous outbound connections found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明，不含可执行 JS 表达式；仓库内其他 YAML 中出现的 !!js 字样均位于研究笔记文档（docs/research/），是介绍 dsh 宿主机制的说明文字，不是插件补丁内容。
evidence.en: The patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only a single insert statement with no executable JS expressions. The !!js occurrences found in other YAML files in the repository are inside research notes documents (docs/research/), serving as explanatory text about the dsh host mechanism, not part of the plugin patch content.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态执行工具（如 cordis_define / cordis_run）的任何调用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic execution tools (such as cordis_define / cordis_run) were found.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装钩子；无 git 依赖（不存在未锁定提交的引用）；仓库中的 GitHub 工作流仅用于 PR 检查与作者向 npm 发布（在 GitHub 基础设施上运行，不随插件安装到用户环境），经审查内容均为常规工程流程（pnpm install/build/test/publish），无恶意行为。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hooks. No git dependencies (no uncommitted commit references). The GitHub workflows in the repository are only used for PR checks and the author's npm publishing (running on GitHub infrastructure, not installed with the plugin into the user environment). Review of their content shows they are normal engineering workflows (pnpm install/build/test/publish) with no malicious behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包（dsh.client），已对其专项检查：唯一的键盘监听用于弹窗 Escape 关闭（contextModal.tsx:72）和图片灯箱 Escape 关闭（images.tsx:72），不记录按键内容；未发现剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或键盘记录行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side package (dsh.client). A dedicated check was performed: the only keyboard listeners are for Escape key to close modals (contextModal.tsx:72) and Escape key to close image lightbox (images.tsx:72), no keystroke content is recorded. No clipboard reading, credential RPC calls, or keylogging behavior found.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用 registerProvider 注册外部子代理，不涉及轮次委派。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call registerProvider to register external sub-agents, so no round delegation is involved.

evidence.zh: 插件未使用 dsh 原生持驻机制（无 jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal/update_goal 调用），未监听 agent/turn-stopping 事件。
evidence.en: The plugin does not use dsh native persistence mechanisms (no calls to jobs.start, schedule_create, create_goal/update_goal), and does not listen to agent/turn-stopping events.

evidence.en: The client's only outbound connection is to the official npm registry to check the latest version of this plugin (src/client/latestVersion.ts:18), used for upgrade hints, containing no sensitive data. No exfiltration chain after reading credentials was found, nor any connections to unknown endpoints.

evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/request or agent/request-error events, and does not call registerAdapter to register custom LLM adapters. No LLM routing runtime hijack surface exists.
